survey_summary.title: AI & Data Science Tooling Survey Executive Summary

top_findings: Python commands a dominant market position with 50.75% preference across all survey cohorts.
Python achieves the highest customer satisfaction score at 4.54 / 5.0.
Older respondents (35-44) exhibit strong enterprise legacy tool loyalty, favoring Excel at 66.7%.
Early-career respondents (18-24) strongly align with modern data stacks, with 69.3% favoring Python.
Power Bi lags in both adoption (6.97%) and satisfaction (2.48/5.0), indicating potential churn or training barriers.
actionable_recommendations: Prioritize advanced Python integrations, modules, and training as the core product ecosystem anchor.
Modernize user workflows and UI/UX for Power Bi to mitigate user dissatisfaction and platform abandonment.
Segment educational campaigns by demographic cohort: promote modern automated scripting to older cohorts and advanced data engineering to younger cohorts.
Maintain seamless Excel interoperability since Excel retains over a quarter of total industry votes.
